scene_end_anchor: Fleeing the initial ambush, the party was hit by an Audit Tax debuff that halved their movement and drained their stamina. They barricaded themselves inside a ruined tollbooth while Unit 734 warned of a second wave of Debt Collectors. Vance defended the door with his Rebar, surviving on exactly 10 HP, while Rhea sacrificed her Scavenger Carapaces to a tether to protect her health. The party survived the timer inside the barricaded tollbooth, exhausted but alive, realizing they had to counter-attack the overseer.

The party was ambushed by System-spawned Debt Collectors.
The hounds bypassed standard damage, using glowing tethers to drain HP and Stamina directly.
Rhea used her physical strength to resist the tether, causing the System to recalculate and target her inventory instead.
The debt tethers seized Rhea's Ash Fungus and Severed Ash-Boar Tusk before Vance crushed the hound.

The party was hit by an Audit Tax debuff that drastically reduced movement speed and drained stamina.
They barricaded themselves inside a Ruined Tollbooth to wait out the debuff timer.
A second wave of Debt Collectors attacked, using tethers to try and drain HP and inventory.
Rhea's stamina was drained to 1/150, and she lost her Scavenger Carapaces to a tether.
Vance successfully defended the door, maintaining his 10 HP until the debuff timer expired and the hounds de-rezzed.
